plan.title: Capability adoption registry with applicability heuristics

narratives.Description: Catalog directive capabilities such as planning, cost, decompose, swarm, pre-PR, debug, glossary, and lessons, each with a conservative applicability heuristic and a usage signal. This registry powers underutilization nudges that only fire on genuinely relevant work.
narratives.ImplementationPlan:
- Add a registry module describing each capability, its applicability heuristic, and its usage-signal source.
- Emit adoption events when applicable-but-unused work is detected and add tests with fixtures covering conservative false-positive avoidance.
narratives.UserStory: As a directive consumer, I want relevant unused capabilities surfaced conservatively, so that I discover planning, cost, or decompose value I am leaving on the table.

narrative.Acceptance: The registry records each capability with an applicability heuristic and a usage-signal source.
When large multi-file work runs without decompose, the registry emits an adoption signal.
The registry rejects adoption nudges for small or non-parallelizable work to avoid false positives.

expected_outputs: Capability catalog with applicability heuristics and usage signals
adoption events emitted for applicable-but-unused capabilities
